class.name: NNArea2DSearchSpace
class.brief_description: Search space containing all [Area2D] nodes currently overlapping a given [Area2D].
class.description: Use when you want an NQS query to search nearby 2D trigger areas (such as pickups, cover zones, or hazards) overlapping [member area2d]. Physics bodies are not included.

members.member: The [Area2D] whose overlapping [Area2D] nodes form the candidate list.
